instruction: Open Terminal and run songsee to create a multi-panel visualization of "$HOME/Desktop/Ode to Joy.mp3" with spectrogram,mel,loudness,mfcc. Set the start time to 14 seconds, duration to 9 seconds, style to inferno, dimensions to 1440 width by 810 height, window 2048, hop 256, and frequency range 100 Hz to 7000 Hz. Save the output as a PNG to "$HOME/Desktop/songsee_combo_2.png".
reference_command: songsee "$HOME/Desktop/Ode to Joy.mp3" --viz spectrogram,mel,loudness,mfcc --start 14 --duration 9 --style inferno --width 1440 --height 810 --window 2048 --hop 256 --min-freq 100 --max-freq 7000 --format png -o "$HOME/Desktop/songsee_combo_2.png"
